rendered.answer: ocA 12 means over-current during acceleration: the output current exceeds three times the rated current during acceleration, the drive closes the output immediately, and the motor runs freely 2. Corrective actions are to check acceleration time and, if it is too short, increase the acceleration time, increase S-curve acceleration time, set auto-acceleration/auto-deceleration parameter P01.44, set over-current stall prevention P06.03, or replace the drive with a larger capacity model 2. Also check the motor cable for short circuits and contact AutomationDirect Technical Support if a hardware failure or short circuit is found 12.

Wait at least 10 minutes after the display lamps go out, and for ≤ 30hp models wait at least 5 minutes; the capacitors are discharged when DC+ to DC- is less than 25VDC 2 1. After that, confirm the DC bus is below 25VDC before inspection 2.
GFF is a hardware protection error when power is ON 1. If it appears before run as b4GF, that means a ground short circuit was detected during output wiring check before the drive runs 1.
An oH1 fault occurs when the IGBT temperature exceeds the protection level, which is the model default of P06.15 + 5°C 1. The drive stops immediately when that limit is reached 1.

⚠️ Safety flag. This task involves a hazard. Isolate and verify zero energy before hands-on work. (p.3) Disconnect the motor from the drive, then apply input power to the drive for 2 hours to recharge the DC link capacitors before use 1. This is required if the drive has been stored or otherwise unused for more than a year; otherwise the capacitors may be damaged when the drive starts to operate 1.

F5 [OverVoltage] means the DC bus voltage exceeded its maximum value, and you should monitor the AC line for high voltage or transient conditions; bus overvoltage can also be caused by motor regeneration, so extend the decel time or install the dynamic brake option 1.
Wait three minutes after removing mains supply before working on the drive 5. The manual also says to isolate mains supply from line inputs [R, S, T (L1, L2, L3)] before work begins 5.

⚠️ Before you reset or restart. Find and correct the cause first — if it trips again, the cause is still there. A reset can restart motion: make sure everyone is clear. Lock out before anyone reaches in. ⚠️ Safety flag. This task involves a hazard. Isolate and verify zero energy before hands-on work. (p.92) Set A092 [Auto Rstrt Tries] to a value other than 0 and A093 [Auto Rstrt Delay] to a value other than 0 to enable automatic fault reset and restart 43. This feature lets the drive automatically attempt a fault reset followed by a start attempt; only certain faults are allowed to reset 3.

Check the active speed-reference source and whether any digital input is overriding it: when A051…A053 are programmed as Preset Speed and active, digital inputs have priority over frequency control, and an active preset input overrides the speed command 12. Also verify P038 [Speed Reference] is set to the intended source, such as 1 “Internal Freq,” 4 “Preset Freq 0-3,” 5 “Comm Port,” 6 “Stp Logic,” or 7 “Anlg In Mult” 34. If the command source is correct, check the active accel time parameter: P039 [Accel Time 1], A067 [Accel Time 2], or A068 [Decel Time 2] set the ramp rate for speed increases/decreases as applicable 453.

F33 [Auto Rstrt Tries] means the drive unsuccessfully attempted to reset a fault and resume running for the programmed number of A092 [Auto Rstrt Tries]. Correct the cause of the fault and manually clear it 1.

F13 [Ground Fault] means a current path to earth ground has been detected at one or more of the drive output terminals 1. Check the motor and external wiring to the drive output terminals for a grounded condition 1.

⚠️ Lockout conflict in a step below: “With the drive isolated, locked out, and before any work on the drive, measure the DC bus voltage at the -DC and +DC terminals on the Power Terminal Block; the ”. That step mixes locked-out work with power on. Inspect, tighten and replace with the equipment locked out; any check that needs power is a separate step, after a qualified person removes the lockout and restores power under your site's energized-work procedure. With the drive isolated, locked out, and before any work on the drive, measure the DC bus voltage at the –DC and +DC terminals on the Power Terminal Block; the voltage must be zero 1. Darkened LEDs or a darkened LCD do not prove the capacitors are discharged 1.

With the drive locked out and the DC bus confirmed dead with a meter, check for a flashing red status light, incorrect P106 [Start Source] or t201…t202 [Digital Inx Select] programming, incorrect input wiring, and the Sink/Source DIP switch setting 1. Also verify the terminal-block inputs with d013 [Contrl In Status]: Input Present = 1, the Start/Run FWD input is I/O Terminal 02, and the Stop input on I/O Terminal 01 must be present for the drive to start 6.

F38 [Phase U to Gnd] means a phase-to-ground fault has been detected between the drive and motor in phase U 1. Check the wiring between the drive and motor, check the motor for a grounded phase, and replace the drive if the fault cannot be cleared 1.

The drive needs at least 0 mm, 25 mm, or 76.2 mm of horizontal clearance depending on the ambient temperature, with the listed ambient operating range from -10 °C to 40 °C or 50 °C 1. Specifically, 0 mm and greater is allowed at -10 °C to 40 °C, 25 mm and greater at -10 °C to 50 °C, and the table also shows 76.2 mm (3.0 in.) clearance 1.

Fault 0001 OVERCURRENT means the output current has exceeded the trip level 2. To fix it, check the motor load and mechanics, acceleration time 2202 and 2205, motor data in Group 99 against the motor rating plate, drive/motor sizing, motor cables and connections including phasing, and the STO cabling for high-frequency noise 2.
Wait 5 minutes after disconnecting the input power before working on the ACS355 1. After that, verify with a multimeter that there is no voltage present before you start working 1.

Stop the drive and disconnect it from the AC power source, then remove the hood if fitted, lever the fan holder off the frame with a screwdriver, lift the hinged holder slightly upward from the front edge, free the fan cable from the clip, disconnect the fan cable, and remove the fan holder from the hinges 1. Only frame sizes R1…R4 have a fan; frame size R0 has natural cooling 1.

Alarm 2035 SAFE TORQUE OFF means the STO (Safe torque off) input was requested and is functioning correctly 2. If this was not expected, check the cabling of the safety circuit connected to STO terminals X1C; if a different reaction is needed, change parameter 3025 STO OPERATION 2.

Fault 0016 EARTH FAULT means the drive has detected an earth (ground) fault in the motor or motor cable 2. Check the motor and motor cable; the manual also notes the cable length must not exceed maximum specifications 2.

0xD011 is a recoverable fault meaning the program scan time exceeded the watchdog timeout value 1. Fix it by checking whether the program is caught in a loop, correcting the logic so the upper limit is not reached, rebuilding and downloading the program, and then putting the Micro800 controller back into Run mode 1. The guide notes this can happen with a Structured Text For loop that runs to the maximum value of the variable, and the watchdog setting defaults to 2 s and generally never needs to be changed 2.
0xF050 means the embedded I/O configuration in the user program is invalid 1. See the corrective actions for recoverable faults on page 155 1.

Insert the microSD card, cycle power to the controller, and wait for the SD status LED to display a steady green light; that indicates the project restore is complete 12. If this is a new controller, use ConfigMeFirst.txt in the root directory of the card to define the controller settings and the restore location 1.

⛔ SAFETY STOP — energized work. I won't give steps for working on this equipment while it is powered. De-energize it, lock out and tag out every energy source, and verify zero energy. Your manual's lockout / disconnect-power procedure is on p.27 — follow that page first. Once it is locked out and verified, ask again and I'll walk you through the job from the manual.
